column1: # scripts/test --all: the fast checks, then every other required check. Same columns as fast.tsv.
# Reviewed list: notes/speed/SKIPPED.md says what this doesn't run and why. No step replays a painting.
# Groups: steps of one group run at the same time, each with its own limit. "s": the slow tests
# (much of it single-threaded) and the thinner's acceptance checks beside the painter build. "w": box-features keeps the cores busy
# compiling, the others mostly wait (git hooks, ffmpeg, Python). lockrun.sh (timing-sensitive) and
# the easel scripts run alone. A step that builds another feature set builds into its own
# directory under $CARGO_TARGET_DIR (short names: the easel tests bind sockets under it, and a
# socket path must stay under 104 bytes): in one directory it would replace target/debug/easel, which
# the tests running beside it execute (a first run's determinism tests found the painter's easel).

column6: cargo test --release -p paint --test thinner_physics --test thinner_pigments --no-run && cargo test --release -p easel --bin easel --no-run

column5: ^\S+: state equal on every baseline field

column6: cargo test -p easel --test boxes -- --ignored --exact a_round_19_log_replays_as_before >"$TMPDIR/slow-r19.out" 2>&1 & a=$!; cargo test -p easel --test determinism -- --ignored --exact hand_time_is_deterministic_across_thread_counts_at_the_live_width state_digests_are_the_same_in_every_replay_at_the_live_width the_rag_replays_the_same_at_the_live_width >"$TMPDIR/slow-det.out" 2>&1 & b=$!; wait $a; ra=$?; wait $b; rb=$?; cat "$TMPDIR/slow-r19.out" "$TMPDIR/slow-det.out"; [ $ra = 0 ] && [ $rb = 0 ]

column9: ^thinner acceptance --all: NOT ALL GREEN: every other required test passed; only check 13 \(b\)'s pre-existing failure remains$

column6: CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/ro" cargo test -p easel --no-default-features --features replay --test smoke
